mathematical_basis.M_i: Original control_transition matrix at DWORD i. Its column1 is C_i; every other column depends only on token flags. No column other than1 can reach carried-TLP mode1. New STP uses mode4.
mathematical_basis.T_i: Original matrix evaluated with carry_end=0. Columns0,2,3,4,5,6,7 are byte-identical to M_i; column1 is the mode1 self-loop. Initial noncarried modes never reach1 so every prefix for initial0,2,3 can be precomputed with T_i.
mathematical_basis.C_i: Extract the three actual known-one-hot-or-zero bits from the frozen transition function column1: c_i1 at bit9, c_i2 at bit17, c_i7 at bit57. Unknown comparisons retain original indexed-write-zero semantics; do not replace them with a permissive boolean assumption.
mathematical_basis.j3_carried: c02*(T2*T1*e2) OR c07*e7 OR (c01 AND c12)*(T2*e2) OR (c01 AND c17)*e7 OR (c01 AND c11)*C2
mathematical_basis.final_modes_j: OR of precomputed (T[j-1]...T0)*e_s gated by original initial_mode[s] for s=0,2,3, and carried_j gated by initial_mode[1]. Word0 remains original initial_mode.
mathematical_basis.logic_domain: Original transition matrices contain known0/1 only: unknown destination index writes no1 to the initializedzero matrix. Four-state initial modes become0/1/X after bitwise gating. AND/OR distributivity is valid on these values. Candidate must prove actual HDL behavior, not only a two-state handwritten model.

bank_context.EDS: When precomputing accepted fullblock, EDS is enabled only for absolute DWORD15; all other token flag bits use the same predecode. During shift current low96bits correspond to current slice.
bank_context.capture: Compute input context from exact accepted input predecode; register beside payload/predecode/headerrelation in existing quarantined bank writer. Reset and shift filler equals exact predecode semantics of zero-filled words at that slice; invalid contexts cannot authorize output.
bank_context.promotion: Copy next context at exactly existing next_valid promotion, then incoming acceptance can overwrite current or next under the unchanged original priority. Never use latest input or global tail to label an older bank.
